correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact two-qubit projective probabilities, direct substitution into I3322 yields the displayed Taylor coefficients. The leading coefficient admits an exact completed-square decomposition, proving the scaling-class bound without numerical optimization. The explicit family has Q=(4/3)theta^2-(25/9)theta^3-(1/9)theta^4+O(theta^5), M_A=-sin^2(theta), and series division gives eta_B^th=3/7+(25/49)theta+(562/1029)theta^2+O(theta^3). Analytic remainders justify the limiting and sufficiently-small-theta quantifiers. The checker re-evaluates the exact probability formula and algebraic identities. The proof does not infer an infinite statement from finite samples.

This is a motivated detector-loophole benchmark rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
